providers.name: Malta Kayak Co.
providers.tagline: Paddle into Malta's hidden sea caves
providers.description: Malta Kayak Co. offers guided and self-guided kayak tours that take you directly into the sea caves and hidden lagoons that are impossible to reach on foot. Glide through crystal-clear Mediterranean waters and explore the coastline the way it was meant to be discovered — from the sea.

discount.label: 10% off any rental or guided tour
discount.instructions: Show this screen at the counter or mention the code when booking by phone or online. Valid throughout 2026.

providers.name: Gozo Sea Adventures
providers.tagline: Snorkelling, diving & kayak on Gozo's wild coast
providers.description: Gozo Sea Adventures runs small-group snorkelling and scuba diving sessions in the crystal waters around Gozo and Comino. Their expert local guides know every hidden cave, arch and reef on the Gozitan coastline — spots that only a boat can reach.

discount.label: 10% off any snorkelling or diving session
discount.instructions: Mention 'Explore Malta' when booking or show this screen at the dive centre in Xlendi Bay.

providers.name: Comino Express
providers.tagline: Private boat transfers to Comino's secret spots
providers.description: Skip the overcrowded ferry and reach the hidden corners of Comino on a private or small-group boat with Comino Express. They drop you at the Natural Window, the Santa Maria Caves and quiet eastern bays that public boats never stop at.

discount.label: 10% off any private boat charter
discount.instructions: Book via their website or WhatsApp and enter code EXPLORE10 in the notes field. Cannot be combined with other offers.
